title: Happy sloth
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- tree branch -->
  <rect x='5' y='72' width='90' height='10' rx='5' fill='#6B4226'/>
  <rect x='5' y='72' width='90' height='4' rx='2' fill='#8B5A2B'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='24' ry='22' fill='#8B7355'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='16' ry='14' fill='#C4A882'/>
  <!-- left arm reaching to branch -->
  <path d='M32 48 Q24 55 26 72 L32 72 Q32 58 38 52 Z' fill='#7A6348'/>
  <!-- right arm reaching to branch -->
  <path d='M68 48 Q76 55 74 72 L68 72 Q68 58 62 52 Z' fill='#7A6348'/>
  <!-- left claws -->
  <ellipse cx='26' cy='72' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#D4C4A8'/>
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='73' rx='3' ry='2.5' fill='#D4C4A8'/>
  <!-- right claws -->
  <ellipse cx='74' cy='72' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#D4C4A8'/>
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='73' rx='3' ry='2.5' fill='#D4C4A8'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='36' rx='20' ry='17' fill='#8B7355'/>
  <!-- face mask -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='38' rx='15' ry='13' fill='#C4A882'/>
  <!-- dark eye patches -->
  <ellipse cx='43' cy='35' rx='6' ry='5.5' fill='#5C4A33'/>
  <ellipse cx='57' cy='35' rx='6' ry='5.5' fill='#5C4A33'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='43' cy='34' rx='3' ry='3.5' fill='#1A1A2E'/>
  <ellipse cx='57' cy='34' rx='3' ry='3.5' fill='#1A1A2E'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='33' r='1.2' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='33' r='1.2' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='40' rx='3.5' ry='2.5' fill='#3D2B1A'/>
  <!-- happy smile -->
  <path d='M42 44 Q50 52 58 44' stroke='#3D2B1A' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='42' r='3' fill='#E8A0A0' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='42' r='3' fill='#E8A0A0' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='32' cy='30' r='4' fill='#7A6348'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='30' r='4' fill='#7A6348'/>
  <!-- leaves on branch -->
  <ellipse cx='12' cy='68' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#4CAF50'/>
  <ellipse cx='20' cy='65' rx='5' ry='3.5' fill='#66BB6A'/>
  <ellipse cx='85' cy='68' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#4CAF50'/>
  <ellipse cx='78' cy='65' rx='5' ry='3.5' fill='#66BB6A'/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='76' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#7A6348'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='76' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#7A6348'/>
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='78' rx='2.5' ry='2' fill='#D4C4A8'/>
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='78' rx='2.5' ry='2' fill='#D4C4A8'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='78' rx='2.5' ry='2' fill='#D4C4A8'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='78' rx='2.5' ry='2' fill='#D4C4A8'/>
</svg>
